caption: Fig.5.6:  Optical isomers (d and l) of [Co(en)3] 3+
note: text_layer null; read from the image. The caption is printed INSIDE target_box_in_crop as the bottom line of the box and is copied exactly, including the double space the book sets after 'Fig.5.6:' and the space it leaves before the superscript charge ('[Co(en)3] 3+'). Ordering: the figure is two mirror-image structures with a dashed mirror line between them, so labels are listed left to right -- the left structure's own labels in spatial order (its bracket charge '3+' first, being topmost, then the chelate labels top, left, bottom, with 'Co' in the middle band), its printed name 'dextro', then the central label 'mirror' that names the dashed line, then the right structure's labels in the same way and its printed name 'laevo'. Known structural loss: a flat list cannot represent that the two halves are non-superimposable mirror images, which is the entire point of the figure, nor which chelate ring sits where. For the record, each structure is a tris-chelate: three ethane-1,2-diamine ligands, each drawn as a curved two-point bridge labelled 'en', around one Co -- in the left drawing they sit at top, left and bottom, in the right drawing (the mirror image) at top-left, right and bottom-left. Notation: the ligand label is printed with letterspacing, as 'e n', and is given here as the single word 'en'; charges are printed as a full-size numeral with a superscript sign and are written '3+'. The right structure's '3+' sits at the very right edge of target_box_in_crop and of the crop (box ends at x=900, the sign is printed at x~890-900) and is slightly clipped, but it is legible and is that structure's own charge, so it is included. Over-included by the crop and excluded as belonging to other blocks: the 'Intext Question' answer panel above ('Tetrahedral complexes do not show geometrical isomerism beca... the relative positions of the unidentate ligands attached to the ce... metal atom are the same with respect to each other.'), the section heading '5.4.2 Optical Isomerism', the right-hand text column ('Optical isom... cannot be ... another. ... enantiomer... that cann... called chira... dextro (d) ... upon the ... plane of ... polarimeter... the left). Op... in octahed... didentate l...') and the top of the next figure below the box (two bracketed structures carrying '2+' charges). The crop is clipped at the RIGHT edge, cutting that prose mid-word; the figure and its caption are otherwise complete. A faint diagonal 'not to be republished' watermark crosses the figure without obscuring any label.
